question: What does choosing a First Ideal key talent immediately grant?
choices: Both of the order's surges, plus a Shardblade
Investiture, the three Stormlight actions and an Ideal goal
Only a spren companion who follows them everywhere
Full Radiant status and the Empowered condition
explanation: The First Ideal talent (level 2+) immediately unlocks Investiture and the three Stormlight actions and grants the goal 'Speak the First Ideal.' The order's two surges come only once that goal is completed.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Choosing a First Ideal Talent

verify: You must be level 2 or higher to choose a First Ideal key talent

question: How much Investiture does a Radiant usually have at the start of a scene?
choices: Full — or just 1 if they start Surprised
explanation: It's assumed a Radiant instinctively breathed in Stormlight beforehand, so they start full. A Radiant who starts the scene Surprised has only 1 Investiture.
verify: you only start with 1 Invest­ iture

question: When can the GM assume a Radiant has enough infused spheres without tracking them?
choices: Always — Stormlight is never worth tracking
When they carry marks worth 3× their Investiture
When they carry at least one infused broam
Only while they're within the walls of Urithiru
explanation: If a Radiant carries marks equal to at least three times their Investiture total (and highstorms are accessible), assume they have enough Stormlight. Track spheres only when the story makes it matter.
verify: at least three times as many marks as your Investiture total

question: What does the Regenerate action do?
choices: Spend 1 Investiture to heal one injury
explanation: Regenerate is a free action: spend 1 Investiture to recover 1d6 + your tier in health. It works even while you're Unconscious or otherwise unable to act.
verify: recover health equal to 1d6 + your current tier

question: What does the Enhance Stormlight action grant for 1 Investiture?
choices: +1 Strength and +1 Speed until the end of next turn
+2 to any one attribute for the whole scene
+1 deflect until the end of the scene
An advantage on your next attack test
explanation: Enhance makes you Enhanced [Strength +1] and [Speed +1] until the end of your next turn. You can keep paying 1 Investiture at the end of each turn to maintain it.

question: How many milestone boxes must be marked on an Ideal goal before the Radiant can speak those Words?
explanation: Each Ideal goal has three milestone boxes, marked for dramatic, philosophy-aligned actions. Once all three are marked, the player and GM can set up the moment to speak the Words.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Ideals and Goals

verify: Once you’ve marked all three milestone boxes

question: What happens the first time a Radiant acts against their Ideals?
explanation: The first infraction has no effect. A second before demonstrably advancing their Ideals costs their highest Ideal and dependent talents, and further breaches strip more.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Forsaking Your Ideals

verify: The first time you act against your Ideals, nothing occurs

question: What does a squire gain while within range of their Radiant?
choices: Access to every one of the Radiant's talents
Investiture 2 and the Stormlight actions within 50 miles
A Shardblade of their own, summoned at will
Nothing at all until they bond their own spren
explanation: Within 50 miles of their Radiant (who must have the Take Squire talent, available after the Third Ideal), a squire can draw Stormlight with Investiture max 2 and use Breathe Stormlight, Enhance and Regenerate. The Radiant may also grant one or both surges at 1 rank.
verify: While within 50 miles of the Radiant

question: Which two surges does the Windrunner order wield?
explanation: Windrunners (honorspren) wield Adhesion and Gravitation. Skybreakers have Division and Gravitation; Bondsmiths have Adhesion and Tension.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Radiant Orders table

question: Which order wields Illumination and Transformation?
explanation: Lightweavers (Cryptics) wield Illumination and Transformation. Truthwatchers have Illumination and Progression; Elsecallers have Transformation and Transportation.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Radiant Orders table

question: How far can a newly bonded spren move from their Radiant before temporarily losing sapience?
choices: 5 feet, the reach of an arm
1 mile, the range of a spanreed
explanation: Spren bond range starts at 30 feet; beyond it a newly bonded spren temporarily loses sapience. The Deepened Bond talent increases the range.

question: A Radiant has 3 ranks in a surge skill. What are their surge die size and surge size?
explanation: Surge Scaling: 1 rank d4/Small, 2 d6/Medium, 3 d8/Large (10 ft), 4 d10/Huge, 5 d12/Gargantuan.

question: How does an infused surge effect use up its Investiture?
choices: All at once, when the surge is first used
1 at the start of each of your turns
It never runs out while you're conscious
explanation: Surges usually expend 1 Investiture at the start of each of your turns, even if you're Unconscious. An object infused with 2 Investiture lasts two rounds.
verify: a surge usually expends 1 Investiture at the start of each of your turns

question: Outside combat, roughly how long does one 'round' of a surge's Investiture last during a conversation?
explanation: Combat: once per 10-second round. Conversation: about once per minute. Endeavor: 1–10 minutes depending on the endeavor. Outside scenes: about every 10 minutes.

question: A tier 2 Radiant is knocked Unconscious at 0 health but still has 3 Investiture. What can they do?
choices: Nothing until someone else heals them
Use Enhance to get back on their feet
Breathe Stormlight, but they can't Regenerate
explanation: Regenerate is usable while Unconscious: 1 Investiture recovers 1d6 + tier (2) health. They can then choose to wake. Breathe Stormlight also works while Unconscious.
verify: You can use this free action even if you’re Uncon­ scious

question: Assassins ambush a party, and the party's Skybreaker (max Investiture 5) is Surprised. How much Investiture does the Skybreaker start the combat with?
explanation: Radiants normally start scenes full, but a Radiant who starts the scene Surprised has only 1 Investiture — enough to maintain ongoing powers.
verify: if you start a scene with the Surprised condition

question: A Radiant with 2 ranks in Adhesion wants to infuse a 10-foot-long cart. Can they?
choices: No — 2 ranks only reaches Medium (5 ft)
Yes, but the test has a disadvantage
Only if they also spend 2 focus
explanation: Surge size scales with ranks: 2 ranks is Medium (5 ft). Unless specified otherwise, you can't infuse an object with any dimension beyond your surge size.
verify: you can’t infuse an object if either its width, length, or height exceeds your surge size

question: A Radiant infuses a door with 3 Investiture to keep it sealed, then fights in the next room. Absent other effects, how long does the infusion last?
choices: Until the end of the scene
explanation: An infusion expends 1 Investiture at the start of each of your turns, so 3 infused Investiture lasts three rounds. The Radiant can add more at the start of a turn if within range. (If the surge isn't relevant to the new scene, the GM may track it more loosely.)
verify: if you instead infuse that object with 2 Investiture, the surge lasts two rounds

question: A Windrunner abandons a defenseless village in a way that clearly breaks their Ideals. It's the second time since they last advanced their Ideals. What happens?
choices: Nothing — only the first breach matters
They lose their highest Ideal and its talents
They lose all Radiant abilities immediately
Their spren dies on the spot
explanation: The first breach is forgiven. A second, before demonstrably advancing their Ideals, weakens the bond: they lose their highest Ideal and talents that require it. They can repair the bond by genuinely rededicating themselves.

cite.section: Ch. 5 Radiant Paths › Forsaking Your Ideals

verify: you lose access to your highest Ideal and its benefits
